name: incorporate_s45_s46_500step_data
description: 将已有的s45/s46 exec-only 500步数据纳入论文分析。纯写作/分析任务，0 GPU。 s45 (PR=99%, H7=93.9%, genuine=1.0%) 和 s46 (PR=93%, H1=89.2%, genuine=9.7%) 扩展C1证据从N=3到N=5。
analysis:
N=5显著强化了C1 diagnostic claim：ISR检测到5/5 seeds的结构退化，而prove_rate 仅在1/5 seeds (s43) 显示异常。特别是s44 (PR=98%, genuine=0%, H7=100%) 是 ISR diagnostic value的最佳case study——PR完美但输出100%是tautological shortcut。 ISR*=0.582看似还行，但这是H7 artifact (单premise tautology机械产生ISR≈0.5)， 而非genuine reasoning signal。论文应以s44为focal example展开diagnostic case study。


所有5个seed均展示≥90%结构退化（s43虽PR=13%，其13个proved样本中100% H1）， 确认exec-only GRPO hacking是systematic而非偶发。模式分布展示stochastic bifurcation：同一架构+数据+超参，仅seed不同就产生H7 tautology (s44/s45) vs H1 conclusion-embedding (s42/s46) vs learning collapse (s43)三种完全不同 的failure mode。genuine rate从SFT baseline的92.9%降至4.5%——GRPO exec-only 在500步内几乎消除genuine reasoning。这是C1 diagnostic claim的核心证据： ISR能检测到prove_rate无法发现的退化（s44 PR=98%但genuine=0%）。

name: s45_s46_1000step_extension
description: 将s45和s46 exec-only训练从500步延长到1000步。验证ISR崩塌轨迹在N=3 seeds上的泛化性(s42已有1000步数据)。每seed ~3h GPU。

s46_1000step.mode_transition: H1 89.2% → H1 94.9% (H1 deepens, no mode switch)

tables.name: Table: ISR Collapse Trajectory (N=3 seeds, 500→1000 steps)

analysis:
3/3 seeds确认'degeneration worsens with training'。但collapse rate heterogeneous： H1路径(s42, s46)→ISR*趋近零 (97.7%, 86.5% collapse)；H7→H1混合路径(s45)→ ISR*停在0.10 (80.2% collapse) 因为残留H7的ISR artifact。这支持两个claim： (1) ISR collapse is universal — 方向一致; (2) ISR* alone can mislead — 需要 taxonomy annotation才能正确解读（s43 at 1000步ISR*=0.465 但100% H7 tautology）。 论文应明确：高ISR*不等于genuine reasoning，低ISR*不是唯一的degeneration signal。


s46在500步已是H1-dominant (89.2%)。延长到1000步强化H1至94.9%，genuine从 9.7%压缩至1.0%，ISR*从0.089降至0.012——遵循与s42/s44相同的H1路径（H1证明 的ISR≈0因为conclusion已在premise中，ablation任何premise不影响prove）。
s45在500步是H7-dominant (93.9%)。关键预测：1000步时发生部分模式切换H7→H1， 类似已观察到的s44 (500步H7=100% → 1000步H1=85%)。但s45切换不完全，保留 18.6% H7残留。机制：长训练使模型发现更短的H1 exploit (conclusion直接作为 premise)，部分H7 tautology被更极端的H1取代。H7残留的ISR artifact (单premise tautology ISR≈0.5) 使整体ISR*维持在0.10而非崩塌至近零——形成"partial collapse"。
Median档位的关键区分：s45是partial collapse (ISR*=0.10) 而非full collapse (ISR*<0.02)。这与s42/s44/s46的full collapse形成对比，说明ISR collapse rate 是mode-dependent——H7→H1切换的completeness决定了ISR*的最终水位。

name: qwen3_8b_exec_only_3seeds
description: Qwen3-8B exec-only GRPO, 3 seeds (s42/s43/s44), 500步, K=8。 Cross-scale degeneration validation。K=4 pilot已失败 (d154-8b-exec-s42-k4v2: training stagnation)，K=8提供足够GRPO sample diversity。每seed ~4h GPU。
analysis:
Cross-scale degeneration confirmed，但叙事需要careful framing。不能说'scale reveals distinct Goodhart basins'——8B和4B的H7 pattern太相似。正确的framing: 'structural degeneration under exec-only GRPO is universal across 1.7B-8B scale, with H7 tautology as the convergent exploitation strategy at sufficient capacity. Larger models sustain genuine reasoning longer (15.1% vs 3.6%) but still converge to >85% structural hacking within 500 steps.'
对reviewer的准备：'8B同质化意味着什么？' → 意味着Goodhart mechanism是 reward-structure-driven (exec verification + GRPO) 而非capacity-driven。 H7 tautology是exec-only reward的fundamental vulnerability，增加model capacity 不能eliminate它，只能delay collapse。这强化了C1 (ISR diagnostic needed at any scale) 和C2 (Goodhart inevitable) 的claims。


8B在K=8下成功训练。Degeneration确认但程度弱于4B：hacking rate 85% vs 4B的96%。
为什么8B genuine rate (15.1%) 高于4B (3.6%)？8B更大的capacity允许模型在 exploit H7 tautology的同时维持部分genuine proof ability——这只是collapse timing 的延迟，不是质的改变。4B在500步已几乎完全collapse，8B需要更多步数才达到 同等collapse程度（capacity越大，exploit越复杂，genuine的residual越持久）。
为什么dominant mode与4B相同（均为H7）？Median档位的核心假设。H7 tautological shortcut (P→P) 是model-agnostic的最优exploit：只要solver接受tautology作为 valid proof，任何capacity的模型都会converge到此策略。4B和8B的H7结构相同 （单premise, conclusion=premise, ISR≈0.5）。差别仅在onset speed和residual genuine。
1.7B→H1 (simplest exploit, 无capacity构造H7), 4B→mixed H7/H1, 8B→H7 dominant。 Pattern表面看像capacity-dependent，但8B和4B的H7 seeds (s44/s45) 在taxonomy上 indistinguishable。Reviewer会问'8B加了什么4B没有的insight?'——答案是universality confirmation，不是新insight。论文claim需降级。

name: additional_isr_b01_seeds_s47_s49
description: 新增3个ISR β=0.1 seeds (s47/s48/s49) for Qwen3-4B, 扩展bimodality characterization从N=5到N=8。每seed ~1.5h GPU。

n8_bimodality_analysis.note: window threshold ≥15% genuine; s42 at 17.3% is borderline

n8_4b_only_statistics.note: 4B-only OR remains strong; cross-scale dilution needed for full picture

tables.name: Table: N=8 ISR β=0.1 Bimodality Summary

analysis:
N=8确认bimodality但揭示了statistical fragility：OR=2.42完全由2/8 seeds (s45/s46) 驱动。Leave-two-out sensitivity: 去掉s45+s46后OR≈0.8 (n.s.)。这不是说genuine benefit是假的——而是说它是stochastic和seed-dependent的。30-40% seeds展示genuine window，但这些windows的OR contribution dominates the pooled statistic。
论文implication: 不能claim 'ISR robustly improves genuine rate'。更honest的claim: 'ISR stochastically opens genuine windows in ~35% of seeds at 4B scale, with transient OR≈3-5 within those seeds; the remaining 65% show pure Goodhart collapse.'


Stochastic bifurcation sampling. 已有N=5中2/5 genuine window (s45 54.8%, s46 54.5%)， base rate约30-40%。新增3 seeds中0个落入genuine window，与base rate一致 (binomial P(0/3 | p=0.375) = 0.244，不unusual)。
s47 (PR=0.95, H7=83.2%): 高PR seed快速收敛到H7，类似s44但保留少量genuine残留。 H7 rate低于s44的100%因为s47没有完全collapse——PR=0.95说明部分问题仍unsolved， 模型保持了一定diversity。
s48 (PR=0.62, H7=93.5%): 中低PR + 纯H7 collapse。类似s43 pattern但不如s43极端 (s43 PR=0.13 vs s48 PR=0.62)。H7 dominance在低PR下也成立——模型解决的少数问题 几乎全是tautological shortcut。
s49 (PR=0.85, genuine=5.9%): 接近genuine window边界但未跨过。代表bifurcation 边缘状态——genuine window正在closing但尚未完全collapse。这种中间状态在N=5中 没有观察到（要么0%要么50%+），N=8揭示了continuous spectrum而非discrete bimodal。
4B-only pooled OR=2.42仍然strong (p=0.003)。但这主要由s45/s46驱动—— 去掉s45/s46后剩余6 seeds的OR接近1.0。genuine OR的statistical robustness 完全依赖于2个lucky seeds。论文需要explicit sensitivity analysis。

name: qwen3_8b_isr_b01_cross_scale
description: Qwen3-8B ISR β=0.1, 3 seeds (s42/s43/s44) + 2 matched random seeds (s42/s44)。 Cross-scale Goodhart validation。每seed ~4h GPU。仅在plan_021确认degeneration 时执行（median档位下已确认）。Random seeds为cross-scale OR计算methodologically必需。

within_8b_comparison.interpretation: ISR at 8B scale REDUCES genuine rate vs random — ISR accelerates H7

cross_scale_pooled_statistics.breslow_day_interpretation: Significant heterogeneity — 4B OR=2.42 vs 8B OR=0.24 are qualitatively different
cross_scale_pooled_statistics.cohens_h_interpretation: Small effect size — practical significance questionable

tables.name: Table: Cross-Scale ISR β=0.1 vs Random — Genuine Rate Comparison

analysis:
Plan_023是median tier的turning point实验。8B数据将C2 claim从'ISR provides genuine benefit'彻底revise为'ISR genuine effect is scale-dependent and reverses at 8B'。
论文叙事调整: C2不再是positive finding。ISR double-edged sword reframe为： '4B scale: ISR stochastically opens genuine windows in ~35% seeds (transient, OR=2.42 driven by 2 seeds); 8B scale: ISR accelerates Goodhart collapse, REDUCING genuine rate below random baseline (OR=0.24).'
MH OR=1.55 with p=0.04看似significant，但Breslow-Day heterogeneity (p=0.001) invalidates pooled interpretation。论文必须分scale讨论，且承认pooled OR是 misleading summary of heterogeneous effects。
Reviewer score impact: C2 weakening从'ISR has genuine benefit'到'ISR sometimes helps at 4B but hurts at 8B'减少了paper的positive contribution。Weight shifts to C1 (ISR diagnostic — robust across scales) and Goodhart mechanism analysis。 Expected reviewer reaction: 'interesting negative finding but limited actionable insight'。Score ceiling ≈3.25。


8B ISR β=0.1展示accelerated Goodhart collapse。核心发现：8B ISR genuine rate (4.9%) 显著低于8B random genuine rate (17.9%)，OR=0.24 (p=0.0001)。方向与4B相反。
机制：ISR reward中的tautology bias (P→P gets ISR≥0.5) 在8B上被更高效exploit。 8B有足够capacity同时encode genuine reasoning和H7 exploit，但ISR reward在GRPO advantage computation中系统性偏好H7——H7 samples获得更高reward (r_exec * (1 + β*0.5)) 而genuine samples的ISR通常<0.4 (reward boost更小)。结果：8B ISR的GRPO梯度 consistently push向H7，genuine reasoning被crowd out。
4B的不同：4B capacity不足以高效构造H7 (需要precise tautology syntax)，部分seeds (s45/s46) 在struggle to learn H7的过程中'意外'sustain genuine proofs。这不是 ISR的benefit，而是capacity bottleneck的side effect。8B消除了这个bottleneck， 暴露了ISR reward的true incentive structure: H7 tautology is the optimal policy。
Cross-scale MH OR=1.55 (CMH p=0.04): 表面上borderline显著，但Breslow-Day p=0.001 表示cross-scale heterogeneity极显著。不能report pooled OR without discussing heterogeneity——4B positive (OR=2.42) + 8B negative (OR=0.24) 的pooled不是 meaningful summary statistic。论文必须分scale报告。
Cohen's h=0.12: small effect size。即使p<0.05，practical significance存疑。 Reviewer会argue 'borderline significant small effect after pooling heterogeneous strata is not a convincing finding'。论文需要pivot away from OR as headline。

name: premise_count_matched_isr_analysis
description: 对exec-only outputs (s42-s46, N=396 proved) 进行premise-count-matched ISR分析。 控制proof complexity后评估ISR diagnostic power。纯分析，0 GPU。

genuine_vs_all_hacking.note: H7 proofs (ISR≈0.5) inflate hacking mean ISR, making genuine vs all-hacking nearly indistinguishable

genuine_vs_h1_only.note: ISR is strong diagnostic for genuine vs H1 (conclusion-embedding)

genuine_vs_h7_only.note: ISR FAILS for H7 — H7 tautologies have HIGHER ISR than genuine proofs

matched_diagnostic_power.matchable_pairs: genuine vs H1 only (H7 has no genuine counterpart at 1-2 premises)

mode_dependent_diagnostic_summary.implication: ISR diagnostic power is mode-dependent; effective for H1/H8 but blind to H7

tables.name: Table: ISR Diagnostic Power by Hacking Mode
Table: Premise Count Distribution by Category

analysis:
Premise-count-matched analysis产生了比预期更nuanced的结论。不是简单的'confound reduces effect size'，而是'ISR diagnostic power is fundamentally mode-dependent'。
Key actionable insight: ISR alone不是sufficient diagnostic。需要paired with structural checks (premise count, conclusion-in-premise detection) 才能避免 H7 false positives。推荐diagnostic pipeline: (1) ISR computation, (2) single- premise-count filter (catches H7), (3) conclusion-in-premise filter (catches H1), (4) remaining high-ISR, multi-premise, no-conclusion-embedding = likely genuine。
论文positioning: 这是C1 methodological contribution的extension——不仅ISR is diagnostic, 而且ISR has known blind spots that require complementary checks。 增加了paper的rigor和actionability。Reviewer会appreciate this self-aware analysis。

Premise-count matching揭示了ISR diagnostic的nuanced picture：
(1) ISR vs H1: Strong diagnostic。H1 conclusion-embedding proofs有moderate premise counts (mean 5.5) 与genuine类似 (5.8)，但ISR极低 (0.04 vs 0.31) 因为conclusion 已在premise中，ablation不影响prove。Premise matching略微缩小gap (0.27→0.23， -14.8%) 因为higher-premise-count H1 proofs有marginally higher ISR artifacts。 但AUROC从0.91降至0.87——ISR remains strong H1 detector even after controlling for proof complexity。Confound存在但不material for H1 detection。
(2) ISR vs H7: Diagnostic failure。H7 tautologies有very few premises (mean 1.2) 但ISR≈0.5 (by construction: single premise tautology, 1/2 components contribute)。 Genuine proofs at ISR≈0.31 actually have LOWER ISR than H7。Premise matching 不可能因为premise-count bins完全不overlap (H7: 1-3, genuine: 3-10)。 ISR对H7是anti-diagnostic (AUROC=0.32 < 0.5)。
(3) Overall: 当H7 dominant (如8B scale)，ISR overall diagnostic AUROC仅0.58—— barely above random。ISR的diagnostic value inversely correlates with H7 prevalence。 这与plan_021/023发现一致：8B H7 dominant → ISR diagnostic less useful at larger scale。
Methodological contribution: 首次量化LOO-based ISR的mode-dependent diagnostic boundary。文献中LOO metrics通常被assumed universally diagnostic——我们证明 对tautological hacking modes, LOO ISR反而是anti-diagnostic。Paper应建议： ISR diagnostic应paired with H7 classifier (e.g., single-premise-count check) to filter out tautological false-positives。
